div.head: Abt 62
div.ab: Gif man gegemed weorðeþ, XXX scill' gebete.
Gif man gegemed weorðeþ, XXX sciƚƚ gebete.
If a person becomes cured [after having been wounded], let him [i.e., the person who caused the wound] pay [with] 30 shillings.
If a man receives medical treatment, 30 shillings shall be paid as compensation.
Wenn jemand [durch die Verwundung gezwungen,] ärztlich curirt wird, büsse [der Missethäter] 30 Schill.
If someone [forced by the wounding] is medically treated, let [the offender] pay 30 shillings.
